freecad.comment: Talks to the FreeCADMCP addon's RPC server (localhost). Requires: (1) `uv`/`uvx` on PATH, or swap to `python -m freecad_mcp` after `pip install freecad-mcp`; (2) FreeCAD running with the MCP RPC server started (Tools > Start MCP Server, or auto_start_rpc in freecad_mcp_settings.json); (3) a Claude Code restart so this server loads.
